Callout.Name: Fire in a Rubbish Bin
Callout.Message: Bin fire at a picnic area.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody about, fire spread to grass.

Script.Line: The bin at the picnic area is alight and it has taken the table.
There is nobody here. It is shut for the season.
It is going towards the gorse and the gorse is dry.

Lines.Approach: Bin fire and it has taken the grass with it. Wind is doing you no favours.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
